title: Finance Assistant
description:
We are currently recruiting for a Finance Assistant to join a busy finance team based in Exeter. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous finance administration or transactional finance experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and has a keen eye for detail.

The successful candidate will support both income and expenditure functions, ensuring financial transactions are processed accurately and on time.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices
- Managing purchase ledger activities
- Supporting payment runs
- Maintaining supplier records
- Assisting with account reconciliations
- Raising sales invoices
- Allocating incoming receipts
- Resolving finance-related queries from internal and external stakeholders
- Supporting the wider finance team with day-to-day administration

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience working within a finance or accounts environment
- Good understanding of accounting and financial administration processes
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Ability to prioritise workload effectively
- Excellent organisational skills
- Confident communication and customer service skills
- A flexible and adaptable approach to work
- Strong team-working ability
- Competent user of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel

What's on Offer
- £14.17 per hour
- Immediate start available
- Temporary assignment through to December 2026
- Modern office location at Exeter
- Opportunity to gain experience within a busy and supportive finance team

If you have finance administration, accounts payable, purchase ledger or finance assistant experience and are available to start at short notice, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today or contact the team for further information.

title: Receptionist
description: Are you warm, organised and passionate about delivering exceptional first impressions? Join Pinhoe View as a Receptionist to be the welcoming face of our hospital and provide vital administrative support across our services. As our Receptionist, you will play an essential role in creating a professional, friendly and supportive experience for everyone who visits the hospital. Youll ensure all visitors are greeted politely, directed appropriately, and that the relevant staff are informed of their arrival promptly and efficiently. Alongside this, youll provide administration support to managers, colleagues and service usershelping to keep our hospital running smoothly while ensuring compliance with organisational policies, procedures and best practice. Shift pattern hours - weekdays: 7:00am 3:00pm or 12:00midday 8:00pm and 1 in 3 weekends: 9:00am 5:00pm. As a Receptionist at Elysium Healthcare, you'll be the first point of contact at Pinhoe View, Exeter. Responsibilities include greeting visitors, directing them appropriately, and managing administrative duties for hospital staff while ensuring compliance with policies. You'll need to maintain professional conduct and manage stressful situations effectively. The role involves working weekdays and one in every three weekends, with varying shift times. Benefits include a competitive salary, annual leave, and access to a range of support and development resources. Are you warm, organised and passionate about delivering exceptional first impressions? Join Pinhoe View as a Receptionist to be the welcoming face of our hospital and provide vital administrative support across our services. As our Receptionist, you will play an essential role in creating a professional, friendly and supportive experience for everyone who visits the hospital. You’ll ensure all visitors are greeted politely, directed appropriately, and that the relevant staff are informed of their arrival promptly and efficiently. Alongside this, you’ll provide administration support to managers, colleagues and service users—helping to keep our hospital running smoothly while ensuring compliance with organisational policies, procedures and best practice. Shift pattern hours - weekdays: 7:00am – 3:00pm or 12:00midday – 8:00pm and 1 in 3 weekends: 9:00am – 5:00pm. As the Receptionist, you will be: To be the first point of contact for staff and visitors at reception, answering inbound calls promptly and professionally. Ensuring that all visitors sign in to meet the requirements of health & safety and are provided with visitors passes so they can be identified as visitors to the hospital. Ensuring that visitors leaving site have signed out so that hospital staff are aware they are no longer on site. Ensure that all keys and alarms are allocated and signed out to staff and signed back in at the end of shift/visit. Ensuring that the key management paperwork is accurately completed so that key management can be evidenced for regulatory purposes. Ensure all visitors to the Hospital read and sign the contraband item list. Complete radio response checks daily to ensure that compliance with radios are adhered to. To be successful in this role, you will be: The ability to always display professional conduct. Ability to establish and maintain positive working relationships. Ability to manage stressful situations. Demonstrated ability to always maintain confidentiality. Accuracy, efficiency, timeliness, and diligence are displayed in the accomplishment of all assigned duties with a minimum of direct supervision. Ability to prioritise duties and responsibilities. Experience using office software (emails, calendars, word and excel) (Essential) GCSE certificate, Grade C or above in English, or equivalent (Essential). With a network of over 80 services across England and Wales covering Mental Health, Neurological, Learning Disabilities & Autism, Children & Education, there is opportunity for you to grow and move. Elysium Healthcare is part of Ramsay Health Care with a global network that extends across 10 countries and employs over 86,000 people globally. title: Service Administrator
company: Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our welcoming Urology team as a Service Administrator (previously known as Medical Secretary). This is an exciting opportunity to support our Clinical team and our patients during their care. This is based at both at the RDUH Exeter and Ottery St Mary Hospital. We actively encourage you to reach out for an informal chat about the role, or to arrange a visit to the department. For more detail about the main duties of this role, please see the job description section below. As a key member of the Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust, you will be joining an exceptional team working together to help our patients to stay healthy, when they need it most. For more information on the Job Description and Responsibilities please click the link below. More detail about the role: Booking appointments from waiting lists Setting up and updating clinics Monitoring waiting times Reviewing patient pathways from the point of referral to treatment Liaising with other health care services Scheduling of Surgery within EPIC Proof reading clinical letters (please not there is no audio typing in this role) Admin MDT support for Clinicians Assisting and supporting other members of the administrative team across the department or division, including telephone calls, resolving enquires for patients, their careers and visitors. Working Pattern: Monday - Friday, hours to be discussed at interview Interview Date: 11th November 2026 For further information please contact: Lydia Fairman, 01392 406127, Lydia.fairman@nhs.net This is a fixed term contract for 12 months. For current NHS employees this post could be a secondment opportunity. As an inclusive employer, the Royal Devon values diversity and is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where everyone can be themselves and reach their full potential. We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, cultures, and abilities. We recognise the advantages of having a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve. Preference will be given to staff with Priority and 'At Risk' status including NHS At Risk staff throughout Devon. The Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust reserves the right to close vacancy when sufficient applications have been received. The Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust was established in April 2022, bringing together the expertise of both the Royal Devon and Exeter NHS Foundation Trust and Northern Devon Healthcare NHS Trust. Benefits We will work together to maintain a culture that develops and supports you and your team. This might include funding for a care certificate, a degree or leadership qualifications. Or it might include days off to study, engage in CPD or rotational placements to help you hone your skills. Wherever you are heading in the NHS, we'll help you get there. Looking after you is important to us. We strive to help our staff create a healthy work-life balance through flexible working schemes and our family friendly policies. If you're starting out in the NHS, you'll start with 27 days paid annual leave (plus bank holidays), rising to 33 days plus bank holidays. You'll benefit from access to our own comprehensive occupational health services, including counselling, onsite wellbeing activities and groups. Salary is not the only financial benefit You'll have access to an extensive range of staff discounts on shopping, fitness and leisure options and you can spread the cost of technology and home appliance purchases from major retailers. You will also have access to other benefits including: National discount services such as the Blue Light Card and Health Service Discounts. Salary sacrifice options including our OFSTED rated outstanding nursery onsite at Exeter Car lease schemes. The NHS Pension scheme (one of the most generous and comprehensive in the UK). Cycle to work scheme These are just a few of the benefits available if the role is something you are interested in, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Administrator
description: Are you looking to start your career with the NHS? Do you want to be part of a friendly and dynamic team? Children & Family Health Devon (CFHD) have a vacancy for a full time Administrator to join our Single Point of Access (SPA) Team based at Capital Court in EXETER. You will be part of a team providing a single access point for our young people, families, clinicians and partners across Devon and Torbay. Main duties include data inputting including referral processing and safeguarding alerts, outgoing telephone calls, use of electronic systems, processing of incoming correspondence via email and post, greeting visitors at reception, scanning, photocopying and general administrative tasks. The key skills you will need to be successful in this role include: excellent administrative skills; communication skills to liaise with children, young people, families and a wide range of healthcare and education professionals; flexibility, calmness and a positive approach; strong organisational skills and the ability to be flexible in line with service needs; and a thorough understanding of confidentiality issues. Full Vacancy details can be found on the attached Job Description/Person Specification. Please refer to your suitability to the post in your supporting information from the role requirements or person specification.
